class.name: OcgAISMultipleconnectedinteractive
class.brief_description: Defines an Interactive Object by gathering together several object presentations. This is done through a list of interactive objects. These can also be Connected objects. That way memory-costly calculations of presentation are avoided.
class.description: ! Defines an Interactive Object by gathering together ! several object presentations. This is done through a ! list of interactive objects. These can also be ! Connected objects. That way memory-costly ! calculations of presentation are avoided.

method.name: AIS_MultipleConnectedInteractive
method.description: Initializes the Interactive Object with multiple connections to AIS_Interactive objects.

method.name: HasConnection
method.description: Returns true if the object is connected to others.

method.name: DisconnectAll
method.description: Clears all the connections to objects.

method.name: AcceptShapeDecomposition
method.description: Informs the graphic context that the interactive Object may be decomposed into sub-shapes for dynamic selection.
